title: The Ferry Building, San Francisco
_comment: Copy to projects/<id>/place-map.json. at: an address as written (with its town), a place's name, or "lat, lon". tint: the film's own colour (#rrggbb), colors: any surface outright. --list prices it (the match, how exact, what is there) and draws nothing; the run writes place_map.jpg, place.json (SK.DATA.place) and preview.jpg -- check the preview first. This one is the map in the kit gallery (config/sketch/kit-example). docs/reference.md, 'A real map of a real address'.
